violation_type.title: Water Activities - Caregiver Must Be Present and Completed Water Safety Course or Lifeguard Required (26 TAC §742.807(e))
violation_type.short_title: Water Activities - Caregiver Must Be Present and Completed Water Safety Course or Lifeguard Required
violation_type.typical_finding: The permit holder allowed children to play in a wading pool and inflatable pool without completing an online water safety course beforehand.
